question: Which forms presided over by deities are to be meditated?
premises: All principles are to be meditated.
Those forms are to be meditated.
inference: Meditation includes all deity-presided forms as principles.
uncertainties: Sandhi and exact declension of tattad remain unresolved.
Gender and number of adhiṣṭhita are inferred from context.
plain_english: All principles, namely the forms presided over by the various deities, are to be meditated upon.
